description: This file contains a JavaScript implementation of a sortable HTML table, including functions for initializing, sorting columns by various data types, event handling, and browser compatibility support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes sortable tables on page load, setting up event listeners and preparing tables.

methods.name: makeSortable
methods.description: Adds sorting capabilities to a specific table, including setting up header click events.

methods.name: guessType
methods.description: Guesses the data type of a column for sorting purposes based on its content.

methods.name: getInnerText
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of a table cell for sorting, handling various node types.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of rows in a table body.

methods.name: sort_numeric
methods.description: Sorts table rows numerically based on cell content.

methods.name: sort_alpha
methods.description: Sorts table rows alphabetically based on cell content.

methods.name: sort_ddmm
methods.description: Sorts table rows by date in dd/mm/yyyy format.

methods.name: sort_mmdd
methods.description: Sorts table rows by date in mm/dd/yyyy format.

methods.name: shaker_sort
methods.description: Performs a stable cocktail shaker sort on a list.
